features.name: Split-Flap Board
features.description: 6x24 split-flap board: BoardMessage/BoardGrid Effect Schema + deterministic layout compiler + repair pass, D1 board/board_snapshot, BoardRoom Durable Object (WS hibernation, one per board, revision-ordered writes), and the full-screen TV display route /b/:boardId targeting the Samsung TV browser.
features.evidence: Phases 1-3 complete. feature-verifier verdict PASS (.brain/features/split-flap-board/verifications/2026-07-27.md), 8 screenshots. flap-tile count exactly 144, grid 24x6, board 1280x640 in a 1280x720 viewport, scrollable=false, zero jsErrors across all 7 steps. Flip measured by in-page rAF sampling: first tile 117ms, peak 42 faces at 267ms, settled by 449ms, mid-flip rotateX ~17.3deg. Settled text read from data-char = HELLO TV / FLAPPYBOARD with 8 yellow + 11 green from data-color. Live two-client sync 1.5ms vs a <300ms bar; board isolation and socket-path D1 persistence proven (board.revision=4 matching snapshots 1-4). Unknown board = true HTTP 404, now with a themed dark kiosk boundary. Gate: typecheck exit 0, Tests 460 passed (460) across 32 files, build exit 0 with the BOARD durable_objects binding + new_sqlite_classes migration present in the emitted build/server/wrangler.json. Fixed en route: a merged Effect layer builds every member so a missing R2 binding was 500ing every request (Bucket moved out of the global runtime); the DO never bumped board.revision; the wire silently relabelled an automation source as manual; and login/signup forms defaulted to GET, putting passwords in the URL when unhydrated.

features.name: Phone Control
features.description: Scan-to-pair phone controller at /b/:boardId/c: short-TTL single-use HMAC pairing token from the TV's QR exchanged for a DO-scoped controller grant (no phone login), manual row/color editor with live preview, history re-flip, and board sound-pack/mute settings.
features.evidence: Phase 4 complete and verified. feature-verifier verdict PASS (.brain/features/phone-control/verifications/2026-07-27.md) with 10 screenshots; golden path 6/6, error paths 2/2, zero jsErrors, zero networkErrors. Core claim proven not assumed: a fresh 390x844 context asserted to hold ZERO cookies redeemed the QR token, ended holding exactly one HttpOnly fb_grant_seed-board cookie and NO auth session cookie, final URL stripped of t=, control-root data-access=grant, and from that state it sent a message, changed sound pack, muted, and re-flipped history. Revision semantics measured from the TVs own WebSocket frames: grid writes 41->42->43 and history re-flip 43->44, while mute plus sound-pack held 42->42 with a byte-identical grid and a captured frame reading revision=42 muted=true. Security: HMAC-SHA256 over crypto.subtle, signed message prefix|boardId.length|boardId|payload giving domain separation plus MAC-audience binding, verify order structure->signature->claims, constant-time compare, 512-char ceiling before crypto, injected clock. Single-use enforced in the board Durable Object under blockConcurrencyWhile: 6 concurrent redemptions of one token returned 200 401 401 401 401 401, and a replay after a full dev-server restart was still refused, proving it is storage-backed. Authorisation matrix on /api/board-ws: no session+no grant on a real board 404, invented board 404, unrelated cookie 404, forged grant 401, real-board grant for an invented board 404, valid grant with no session 101, owner session 101 — so non-enumerability depends only on what the caller sent. Gate: typecheck exit 0 with 0 error TS lines, Tests 538 passed (538) across 34 files, build exit 0. NOT PROVEN: the final mute->silence hop (playerRef.setMuted) is Web Audio and not observable headlessly; frame delivery at an unchanged revision is proven, the audible result is not. ALSO OUTSTANDING: the controller UI is functional but unstyled relative to the board, and its white/black colour swatches are visually identical — both tracked as follow-up work, neither affecting the verified behaviour.
